def builtin_timings(name: str) -> JedecTimings:
    """Convenience loader for the CSVs vendored in this package.

    Usage:
        timings = builtin_timings("ddr3-1600")
    """
    here = Path(__file__).parent / "jedec"
    return load_timings(here / f"{name}.csv")
